title: Rhipper project
description: A Rhipper project: a reference binary and the source tree its translation goes into. Every relative path is relative to this file.

name.description: The name of the port. The build target and the run use it.

rhipper.description: The Rhipper directory for this project. It overrides the IDE setting.

arch.description: The architecture of the reference binary. Each one has its own translator.

toolchain.description: The compiler that built the reference, as rhtest names its toolsets (msvc-16.00-x86). toolchain.py reads it off the binary. Set it where the binary hides it.

image_base.description: The image base of the reference.

gen.description: Where the translator writes the generated sources.

build.description: The CMake build of the port.

run.description: How the pipeline runs the port.

cwd.description: The working directory of the port.

with.description: Side processes that start before the port and stop after it, for example a server it talks to. {out} is the log directory.

screenshot.description: A command that captures the window every 15 s. {out} is the path of the image.

ghidra.description: The headless Ghidra install and the project in it.

install.description: The Ghidra install. A glob such as C:/tools/ghidra_* is allowed.

projects.description: The directory of the Ghidra projects.

program.description: The name of the program in the Ghidra project.

plugins.description: Project modules that the pipeline calls into.

facts_extra.description: Project fact extractors, which run with the others.

jobs.description: The workers of a 32-bit pipeline's steps (protos32, translate32, the build's /m). Fewer on a machine another translation shares.

import_overrides.description: Imports whose adapters the project supplies.

gotchas_reviewed.description: The imports whose 32-bit to 64-bit gotchas a person reviewed, with the reason each one is safe.

process.description: The process name of the reference, for iat_dump.py.

env.description: The prefix of the port's environment variables. The default is the project name in capitals.
